legacy_root.title: Contract: Compatibility matrix contract and the representation of an untested cell
legacy_root.question: Specify the compatibility matrix: the axes (operating system, client and version, shell, package version), the support tiers, how a cell is populated with EVIDENCE, and - most importantly - how an UNTESTED cell is represented so it can never be read as a pass. Define the rule that a cell may only be marked supported by a recorded test run, and that inference from an adjacent cell is labelled INFERRED, never SUPPORTED.

definitions.operating_system: Host OS of the recorded run: linux | windows | macos. A cell is keyed by the OS that actually executed, not the OS the author intended to cover.
definitions.client: Host client identity. Declared set: claude-code, codex-cli, antigravity (agy), mcp-generic.
definitions.client_version: Observed client VERSION string from inside the client. UNPINNED means no pin is published and cannot be SUPPORTED. An installer exit code is not a version.
definitions.shell: Shell that invoked the smoke journey: bash | powershell.
definitions.package_version: Observed package/plugin version under test. UNPINNED cannot be SUPPORTED.

support_tiers.rule: A tier is a planning attribute, never a status and never a pass. T1/T2/T3 without evidence remain NOT-CHECKED.
support_tiers.T1: Must have in-client evidence before a support claim.
support_tiers.T2: Best-effort; still NOT-CHECKED until a receipt exists.
support_tiers.T3: Experimental; still NOT-CHECKED until a receipt exists.

cell_statuses.SUPPORTED: Only a recorded in-client test run whose receipt names the observed client VERSION. Never inferred. Never an installer exit.
cell_statuses.FAILED: Recorded in-client run with result=fail. Survives into the table.
cell_statuses.INFERRED: Guess from an adjacent SUPPORTED cell (adjacent OS, same client, version, shell, package). Machine status INFERRED. is_pass=false. Never SUPPORTED. Distinct glyph, token, and css_class from SUPPORTED.
cell_statuses.NOT-CHECKED: No accepted in-client receipt for this cell. Canonical machine status. Display alias UNTESTED. Never a pass, never blank, never green, never SUPPORTED. Removing a receipt MUST revert the cell to NOT-CHECKED rather than staying green.
cell_statuses.NOT-APPLICABLE: Combination cannot exist (example: cmd on non-Windows).

population_procedure: Enumerate the cartesian product of declared axes. Every tuple is a cell.
Scan evidence roots for receipts. Reject installer-exit, unpinned versions, and intended!=observed version.
Accepted pass -> SUPPORTED. Accepted fail -> FAILED. Never omit FAILED.
Every remaining applicable cell is NOT-CHECKED with a reason. Never blank.
If infer=true, neighbours of SUPPORTED (adjacent OS only) become INFERRED, not SUPPORTED.
If untested_cell_count==0 and the program has run on one platform, emit defect all-green-on-partial-estate.

tests_required.requirement: Remove a test result and assert the cell reverts to NOT-CHECKED rather than staying green
An inferred cell must be visually and machine-distinguishable from a tested one

legacy_root.evidence_requirement: The matrix generator is run over the current test evidence and the untested-cell count is reported; a matrix with no untested cells on a program that has run on one platform is itself a defect.
